rationale: The discourse has clarified the economic and governance trade-offs, but the core clash remains unresolved: employee and state stakeholders still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management and capital insist on material structural savings and keep closures on the table. The last two rounds added quantified framing and expert analysis, but no side has substantively moved, so further unstructured rounds are likely to repeat the same positions unless an external intervention or mediated option comparison is imposed.
